findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: run_compliance_analysis, run_planar_filter, design_patch_antenna · Private data: run_planar_filter · Public sink: run_thermal_analysis, run_pdn_analysis, run_compliance_analysis, run_ota_link, run_radar_performance, run_planar_filter, design_patch_antenna, run_glass_weave_analysis · Destructive: run_link_budget, run_stackup_solver, run_thermal_analysis, run_pdn_analysis, run_compliance_analysis, run_ota_link, run_radar_performance, run_planar_filter, run_glass_weave_analysis, check_grounding.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: run_compliance_analysis, run_planar_filter, design_patch_antenna · Private data: run_planar_filter · Public sink: run_thermal_analysis, run_pdn_analysis, run_compliance_analysis, run_ota_link, run_radar_performance, run_planar_filter, design_patch_antenna, run_glass_weave_analysis · Destructive: run_link_budget, run_stackup_solver, run_thermal_analysis, run_pdn_analysis, run_compliance_analysis, run_ota_link, run_radar_performance, run_planar_filter, run_glass_weave_analysis, check_grounding

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
